Name: The Amazing Deathicorn Redux 2.0 (now you can use lasers with any horse)
Author: deleted285543707
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00]*[/color]If you [color=#00ff00]like[/color] my [color=#00ffff]mods[/color] consider [color=#ff0000]Endorsing[/color]![color=#ffff00]*[/color][/b]

2.0 now lets you use the laser system with any horse! Simply do not use the Deathicorn content patcher horse texture replacement.

Taken from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/362]original mod[/url] description with two edits by my self involving the laser and it being on fire.

"Have you ever wanted a Deathicorn!? What? No? Oh. Well this is awkward...

This mod replaces the boring vanilla horse with the amazing Deathicorn! The Deathicorn isn't by any means a regular horse, we're not even sure if it's a robot or not! The Deathicorn is capable of doing amazing things! It never sleeps, so you'll always have a guardian for your farm! The Deathicorn can shoot lasers from it's horn! (**[s]Disclaimer, does not actually shoot lasers[/s]** [b]The Redux DOES in fact shoot lasers, even when not mounted![/b]) The Deathicorn is on fire! (Literally, [b]the Redux now GLOWS because it's on fire![/b]) Replace your boring horse with a Deathicorn today!"

This comes with a plethora of options if you have GMCM installed to customize it to you're personal liking.

A big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Rgbunpro?gameId=1303]Rgbunpro[/url] for creating the original and giving me their blessing to upload it.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
